questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Brown ring test is to detect the presence of
questions.solution:
To determine the presence of nitrate ion in any solution, a chemical test called brown ring is conducted. Almost all nitrates dissolve in water and therefore determining the presence of nitrate through wet chemistry is not easy when compared to conducting tests for other anions.

The overall reaction is given below&

Reduction of the nitrate ion, oxidation of iron and reduction of nitric oxide. $2HN{O}_{3} + 3{H}_{2}S{O}_{4} + 6FeS{O}_{4} \to 3F{e}_{2} ( S{O}_{4}{)}_{3} + 2NO + 4{H}_{2}O [ Fe ( {H}_{2}O{)}_{6} ] S{O}_{4} + NO \to [ Fe ( {H}_{2}O{)}_{5} ( NO ) ] S{O}_{4} + {H}_{2}O$

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which one of the following will not give flame test?
questions.solution: Beryllium having smallest atomic size in the group 2 has tightly held outermost electrons that do not get excited significantly during flame test.
